newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Stomil Sanok IPO heavily oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Polish Stomil Sanok IPO heavily oversubscribed.

text.p: Investors registered for 4,509,853 shares in the 500,000-share November initial public offering of Polish rubber producer Stomil Sanok SA, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
The statement said 3,144 subscribers had their bids reduced by 88.91 percent.
Investors registered for up to 20,000 shares each in the offering that lasted from November 4 to November 15 at 25 zlotys a share. @
Before the issue Sanok, which plans to enter the main market of the Warsaw bourse at the turn of the year, had 4.7 million shares, all approved for public trade.
The company's main shareholders are the Polish-American Enterprise Fund and the Polish Private Equity Fund I and II, which before the issue together held 78.7 percent of the firm.
